lines.beaver_en: Excuse me, are you looking for something? Can I help?
lines.learner: 네, 시립 도서관에 가려면 어떻게 가야 해요?
lines.en: Yes, how do I get to the city library?
lines.roman: ne, sirip doseogwane garyeomyeon eotteoke gaya haeyo?

lines.beaver: 도서관이요? 이 길로 쭉 가면 사거리가 나와요.
lines.beaver_en: The library? Go straight down this road and you'll reach an intersection.
lines.beaver_roman: doseogwaniyo? i gillo jjuk gamyeon sageoriga nawayo.
lines.en: Do I have to cross the crosswalk at the intersection?

lines.beaver: 네, 횡단보도를 건너세요. 십 분쯤 걸려요.
lines.beaver_en: Yes, cross the crosswalk. It takes about ten minutes.
lines.beaver_roman: ne, hoengdanbodoreul geonneoseyo. sip bunjjeum geollyeoyo.
lines.en: Even looking at the map, I don't know which road it is.

lines.beaver_en: That's okay. After you cross, there's a three-way intersection.
lines.en: Which way do I go at the three-way intersection?

lines.beaver_en: It's to the right. After that there's a big road.
lines.learner: 그 길은 육교로 건너요, 지하도로 건너요?
lines.en: Do I cross that road by the overpass or the underpass?
lines.roman: geu gireun yukgyoro geonneoyo, jihadoro geonneoyo?

lines.beaver: 둘 다 있어요. 육교보다 지하도가 빠를 것 같아요.
lines.beaver_en: There are both. I think the underpass is faster than the overpass.
lines.beaver_roman: dul da isseoyo. yukgyoboda jihadoga ppareul geot gatayo.
lines.learner: 비가 올 것 같아서 지하도로 갈게요.
lines.en: It looks like it'll rain, so I'll take the underpass.
lines.roman: biga ol geot gataseo jihadoro galgeyo.

lines.beaver_en: There's a green sign at the underpass entrance.
lines.en: Is the library on that sign too?

lines.beaver: 네, 흰색 글씨로 도서관이라고 쓰여 있어요.
lines.beaver_en: Yes, it says 'Library' in white letters.
lines.beaver_roman: ne, huinsaek geulssiro doseogwanirago sseuyeo isseoyo.
lines.en: Can I see the library when I come out of the underpass?

lines.beaver: 네, 갈색 건물이 도서관이에요. 최근에 새로 지었어요.
lines.beaver_en: Yes, the brown building is the library. It was built recently.
lines.beaver_roman: ne, galsaek geonmuri doseogwanieyo. choegeune saero jieosseoyo.
lines.learner: 이제 길을 잘 찾을 수 있을 것 같아요.
lines.en: I think I can find the way now.
lines.roman: ije gireul jal chajeul su isseul geot gatayo.

lines.beaver: 네, 조심히 가세요. 모르면 또 물어보세요.
lines.beaver_en: Okay, take care. Ask again if you get lost.
lines.beaver_roman: ne, josimhi gaseyo. moreumyeon tto mureoboseyo.
lines.en: Thank you so much for your kind directions.
